lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Vanuatu through volunteered geographic information and AI-assisted mapping. The dataset contains approximately 201,300 building polygons with structural attributes including building type, number of levels, materials, and address information. Data currency averages 3 years with minimal recent updates.
